_comment: PS5: easiest is Settings > From a phone. Or copy this file to config.json in /data/homebrew/PPSA99520/.
Linux: copy it to ~/.config/regie5/config.json. Fill in each service's address and API key.
https:// works; add "insecure": true to a service whose certificate is self-signed.
url may hold a path (https://example.lan/radarr) when a service sits behind a reverse proxy.
A service is one object, or a list of named instances, e.g. two Radarr:
is4k (Radarr, Sonarr; false by default): true for the instance Seerr uses as its 4K server.
It is never guessed from the name. See docs/CONFIG.md.
Emby instead of Jellyfin: rename "jellyfin" to "emby" (same fields). One media server only.
Plex instead (beta): "plex": {"url": "http://192.168.1.10:32400"}, signed in from the phone page (it adds "token").
